name: Khazarad, Junction of Iron Street and South Alley
desc1: This broad, flagstone-lined street runs along the southern wall of the
desc2: dwarven city. The cave wall to the south has been worn flat, smoothed,
desc3: and engraved with intricate, angular designs. To the north, a smaller
desc4: street breaks off of the main street to pass between two stone houses,
desc5: and Iron Street continues to the east and west.
